name: Ultimate Online football contact animation library
rig: football_player.fbx (Mixamo, mixamorig: bone names, 65 bones, 53 rig units = one player height)

usage.selection: The server/MASS decides the outcome. Pick clips by interaction + outcome (+ contact angle, speed, intensity), then choose variant with seed % 3 (0=base, 1=va, 2=vb) and mirrored=true when the defender is on the runner right. Never reroll in the animation layer.
usage.start_positions: start_offset_x (+x = runner left) and start_offset_back (negative = in front of the runner) in rig units, per defender. Start every participant clip on the same server tick.
usage.size_adaptation: Use contact_targets JSON (bone + offset + weight) with a two-bone arm IK for other body builds; do not scale the skeleton.
